events.text: Launch from Earth
Change orbit to 35786 km
Goal achieved: Reach geostationary orbit
Goal achieved: Send weather images
Goal achieved: Measure ozone and aerosols
Goal achieved: Sound rain and cloud layers with radar
Operations contract: A stable operations contract gives the ground team better support for the weather mission.
First image downlink: Limited partner tracking makes the first image downlink less certain. Mallory has already announced his broadcast slot.
Thruster glitch during the orbit raise: The supplier's prompt thruster support improves the orbit-raise team's readiness.
Arrival at the geostationary slot: The moved launch left less rehearsal time and more uncertainty about the final trim burn.
